headline: carbonapi jumps from 635th to 84th on ARC-3

sections.text: carbonapi gained 3.63 to reach 34.14, moving from 635th to 84th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The rise puts the entry inside the top 100, though the 38.22 gold line remains ahead.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
